taxonomy.purpose: Navigation and search metadata only; never a prescription or permission to share strength estimates.

categories.label: Squat
categories.description: Knee-dominant bilateral or single-leg squat/leg press. Split squats live under Lunge / step.

categories.label: Hinge
categories.description: Deadlift, RDL, good morning, swing and back-extension patterns.

categories.label: Bridge / hip thrust
categories.description: Supported bridge and hip-thrust hip extension, distinct from a standing hinge.

categories.label: Lunge / step
categories.description: Split squat, lunge, step-up and controlled step-down.

categories.label: Horizontal push
categories.description: Bench/floor press and push-up. Inclines stay here; handstand/pike push-ups do not.

categories.label: Vertical / angled push and dip
categories.description: Overhead or landmine press and dips. Dips are a practical push grouping, not an overhead movement.

categories.label: Horizontal pull
categories.description: Rows including bodyweight, cable and sled rows.

categories.label: Vertical pull
categories.description: Pull-up/chin-up, lat pulldown and rope climb. Upright rows and pullovers are shoulder accessories.

categories.label: Core / trunk control
categories.description: Trunk flexion, rotation/resistance, bracing, crawling and get-up patterns.

categories.label: Carry / loaded march
categories.description: Moving with load, including rucking. A stationary grip hold is not a carry.

categories.label: Isolation / accessory
categories.description: Joint-focused arm, shoulder/scapular, hip, knee, ankle, neck and grip accessories.

categories.label: Jump / throw / Olympic lift
categories.description: Jumps/bounds/landings, throws/slams and Olympic lifts/pulls. Explosive push-ups retain their push category and get a plyometric tag.

categories.label: Locomotion / conditioning
categories.description: Run, cycle, erg, rope skipping, sled locomotion, agility and general conditioning. Does not define intensity or a workout.

categories.label: Mobility
categories.description: Named stretches, joint-control and mobility drills. Loaded exercises with similar names are reviewed separately.

categories.label: Preparation / recovery
categories.description: General warm-up, breathing, cooldown and rest; not a specific strength movement.

categories.label: Mixed movements
categories.description: Identifiable combinations spanning movement patterns. Secondary categories aid search without splitting the original identity.
